en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European valley town with terraced vineyard hills in the background. In the left foreground stands a tall neo‑Gothic brick church with a slender spire and cross. Behind and to the right stretches a very large complex of long, uniform three‑story blocks resembling military barracks or an institutional campus. At the bottom edge are roofs along a rail line with steam/smoke. Two tall factory chimneys rise on the far ridge.
